title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed the PCMag, Consumer Reports, RTINGS, and Tom’s Guide articles that all mention the Ikea Symfonisk Bookshelf Speaker.
assumptions: No price information is provided in the sources, so price is omitted.

verdict.line: Picture a living room where you want a Sonos‑quality sound without the price tag. The Symfonisk delivers bright highs and solid bass, works with the Sonos app, and doubles as a shelf. The catch: it has no Bluetooth and can distort on deep bass at high volumes.
